# Vendored Asio

This directory contains the `asio/include` tree from Asio `asio-1-30-2`
(Asio version `1.30.2`). It is distributed under `LICENSE_1_0.txt`.

Upstream source archive SHA-256:

`755bd7f85a4b269c67ae0ea254907c078d408cce8e1a352ad2ed664d233780e8`
